metadata.title: Cloud Third-Party Access

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing and constraining access to cloud environments by third parties, partners, vendors, and external services.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Third-party integrations, delegated access models, federated identities, APIs, service principals, and vendor-managed cloud access.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for establishing trust and governance boundaries for third-party access to cloud resources.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Third-party access relies on cloud-native identity and authorization mechanisms.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Credential access through compromise of third-party accounts or integrations.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Privilege escalation via overly permissive third-party roles or delegated trust.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Lateral movement from third-party access paths into core cloud resources.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Defense evasion by abusing trusted third-party integrations or disabling visibility.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid third-party or partner cloud accounts.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Trust relationship abuse through compromised vendor or partner access.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Privileged access management applied to third-party and vendor identities.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Separation of duties between internal administrators and external parties.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Monitoring and auditing of third-party access and activity.

metadata.remarks: Cloud Third-Party Access defines the trust properties required to safely grant cloud access to external entities. This pattern explicitly models the elevated risk introduced by vendors, partners, and integrations, ensuring access is constrained, attributable, and continuously monitored.

components.title: Third-Party Identity Governance
components.description: Governs identities and credentials used by third parties within cloud environments.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Third-party identities are explicitly governed and limited to approved access scopes.

components.title: Delegated Access Boundaries
components.description: Constrains the scope, duration, and permissions of delegated third-party access.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Delegated access is bounded to minimize blast radius and unintended exposure.

components.title: Third-Party Activity Observability
components.description: Provides visibility into actions taken by third parties in cloud environments.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Activities performed by third parties are observable and attributable.
